instruction: A clean studio photograph with a full-length shot at eye-level. In a minimalist white studio, three women stand in a playful diagonal line. In the center, the woman in the green blazer (R3) stands behind her, wrapping her arms around the waist of the woman in the lavender shirt (R2). On the right, the woman in the blue blazer (R1) stands behind the woman in the green blazer (R3), wrapping her arms around her chest and smiling at the camera. Bright, even studio lighting casts soft shadows on the white floor.
